mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equities, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts central bank policy accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1550 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 610,000 million dollars signal a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1550 and RSAFS < 610000 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to rising discount rates compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0% annualized, it signals strong economic momentum that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).
